title: Taking Back an Unspent Allowance at the Close of a Benefit Period
content:
An allowance belongs to the benefit period it was loaded for, and what is left of it when it reaches the end of its life is dealt with on the card's own expiry basis. This is the standing basis of the Supplemental Benefit Allowance Programmes for closing a benefit period on a Ridgecrest Healthy Options Card.

**What it governs.** The allowance taken back off the card at the close of the benefit period it belonged to, and the benefit period that entry is placed in. The spendable balance held on the programme falls by the amount taken off, and the member sees the entry and the reduced balance on their next statement and on the card.

**How the entry is booked.** The representative unlocks the agent tool `post_period_expiry_1d3932f1` and calls it. One call books a single entry on that card's running record that names the load whose unspent part is being taken back, carries the amount taken off, and is placed in the benefit period whose allowance it ends.

**Parameters.**

- `allowance_program_id` — Id class: the reference number of the allowance programme whose card the allowance is taken off, as it is returned by a lookup of the member's allowance programmes.
- `customer_id` — Id class: the member reference number the programme belongs to, as it is returned by the member profile lookup.
- `source_ledger_entry_id` — Id class: the reference number of the single load entry whose unspent part is being taken back, as it is returned by a lookup of that card's own entries.
- `expiry_amount` — Fixed-format class: the allowance taken off the card, in USD to 2 decimal places, a positive figure; the direction is carried by the entry itself, so no minus sign is used, and an empty value is not accepted.
- `benefit_period` — Fixed-format class: the benefit period whose allowance is being ended, written as a benefit period as YYYY-Qn, for example 2026-Q2, with the quarter in upper case and no spaces.

**What comes back.** A single line of confirmation text carrying the reference number of the expiry entry created, the amount taken off in USD to two decimal places, the benefit period the entry was placed in, and the spendable balance the programme stands at once the allowance is off. A line carrying that reference number is what indicates the entry was booked.
